expression:
local({
  past_year <- cbind(
    readr::parse_number(as.character(PT0031_12M)),
    readr::parse_number(as.character(PT0050_12M)),
    readr::parse_number(as.character(PT0051_12M)),
    readr::parse_number(as.character(PT0281_12M))
  )
  ever <- cbind(
    readr::parse_number(as.character(PT0031_NB)),
    readr::parse_number(as.character(PT0050_NB)),
    readr::parse_number(as.character(PT0051_NB)),
    readr::parse_number(as.character(PT0281_NB))
  )
  current <- rowSums(past_year == 1, na.rm = TRUE) > 0
  none_past_year <- !current & rowSums(past_year == 2, na.rm = TRUE) > 0
  never_ever <- rowSums(ever == 1, na.rm = TRUE) == 0 & rowSums(ever == 2, na.rm = TRUE) > 0
  case_when(
    wave == "1" ~ NA_character_,
    current ~ "Currently diagnosed",
    none_past_year & chronic_told_before %in% TRUE ~ "Previously diagnosed",
    none_past_year & chronic_told_before %in% FALSE ~ "Never diagnosed",
    never_ever ~ "Never diagnosed"
  )
})
